name: Chimelong Spaceship Hotel
description: The most iconic and extraordinary hotel at Chimelong Ocean Kingdom Resort — the Spaceship Hotel is a magnificent futuristic structure shaped like a giant spacecraft hovering above the ocean. Features spectacular ocean-view rooms, multiple themed pools, aquarium-view suites and the most visually stunning hotel architecture in China.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Futuristic themed room with ocean views, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Ocean View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with panoramic South China Sea views and upgraded amenities.

rooms.name: Aquarium Suite
rooms.description: Extraordinary suite with floor-to-ceiling aquarium walls and underwater lighting.

name: Chimelong Penguin Hotel
description: A charming and uniquely themed hotel celebrating the beloved penguins of Chimelong Ocean Kingdom — features penguin-themed rooms, a spectacular indoor penguin habitat viewable from the hotel lobby and direct access to the ocean kingdom. One of the most delightful family hotel experiences in China.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Penguin-themed room with fun decor, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious penguin-themed family room sleeping up to 4 guests.

rooms.name: Penguin Suite
rooms.description: Deluxe suite with upgraded penguin theming, lobby penguin views and breakfast.

name: Hyatt Regency Hengqin
description: A elegant 5-star international hotel on Hengqin Island adjacent to Chimelong Ocean Kingdom — the Hyatt Regency Hengqin features beautifully appointed rooms, multiple restaurants, a full spa, fitness centre and stunning South China Sea views. The finest international luxury hotel near Chimelong Ocean Kingdom.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant 5-star room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and marble bathroom.

rooms.name: Sea View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with stunning South China Sea views and upgraded amenities.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area, sea views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Hengqin Bay Hotel
description: A stylish and comfortable 4-star hotel on the Hengqin Island waterfront near Chimelong Ocean Kingdom — offering modern rooms, a pool, gym and beautiful bay views at competitive prices. Excellent value for families visiting Chimelong Ocean Kingdom.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable 4-star room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Bay View Room
rooms.description: Room with beautiful Hengqin Bay views and upgraded furnishings.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family room sleeping up to 4 guests with bay views and breakfast.
